correctness.rationale: PASS: Finite max–min distributivity yields rooted directed length-k walk maxima. For k>=1 each simple path has k+1 independent threshold variables and mean (n-1)_k t_k^(k+1). For distinct paths with h common primitive variables and v shared nonroot vertices, the structural overlap h<=v yields O(n^{a/(a+1)h-v})=O(n^{-1/(K+1)}) after pair counting; dependency-graph Chen–Stein gives joint zero-event Poisson approximation. Repeated-vertex walks use <=k-1 nonroot vertices and contribute O(n^{-1/(k+1)}). Thus all fixed-depth survival tails factor with the stated rate. Independently enumerated all binary-valued models n=2 (64) and n=3 (4096), four depths, every root, confirming the path identity. Boundary x=0 by continuity; K fixed; no general correlated model conclusion.
